parsed.name: Gamry电化学工作站
parsed.description: 一种用于电化学实验的台式电化学工作站（恒电位/恒电流仪），可施加设定的电位扫描并采集电流等响应信号，常用于循环伏安、线性扫描和电位斜坡类测试。
parsed.description_en: A bench-top electrochemical workstation (potentiostat/galvanostat) used for electrochemical experiments. It applies programmed potential scans and records response signals such as current, commonly for cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep, and potential ramp measurements.

actions.description: 打开与电化学工作站的通信连接。
actions.description_en: Open communication with the electrochemical workstation.

actions.description: 关闭与电化学工作站的通信连接。
actions.description_en: Close communication with the electrochemical workstation.

actions.description: 设置测量或数据采集模式。
actions.description_en: Set the measurement or data acquisition mode.

actions.description: 启动测量，按设定的电位程序施加信号并采集电化学数据。
actions.description_en: Start a measurement, apply the configured potential program, and acquire electrochemical data.

actions.description: 获取设备或当前测量状态。
actions.description_en: Get the device or current measurement status.

actions.description: 导出或读取已采集的测量数据。
actions.description_en: Export or retrieve the acquired measurement data.

actions.description: 执行电位斜坡扫描测量，从初始电位扫到终止电位并记录响应。
actions.description_en: Run a potential ramp scan from the initial to the final potential and record the response.

actions.description: 执行循环电位扫描测量，在设定电位范围内往返扫描多个循环并记录响应。
actions.description_en: Run a cyclic potential scan over the specified potential range for multiple cycles and record the response.

actions.description: 模拟一次电化学测量过程或数据输出。
actions.description_en: Simulate an electrochemical measurement process or data output.
